title: World Cup Day 4: Australia beat Turkey 2-0
excerpt: Group D action at BC Place in Vancouver on June 14.
body:
Day 4 of the 2026 FIFA World Cup delivered 1 match and 2 goals on Sunday, June 14. The tournament, spread across the United States, Canada, and Mexico, continued its group stage with action that will resonate in standings tables and living rooms alike — not least in the Indian-American households tuning in from cities that are, for once, hosting the spectacle rather than streaming it from half a world away.

Here is everything you need to know.

Australia 2-0 Turkey

Group D · BC Place, Vancouver

Australia put in a controlled, professional performance to dispatch Turkey 2-0 at BC Place. It was the kind of win that doesn't make highlight reels but earns respect in tournament football — composed at the back, incisive going forward, and ruthless when it mattered.

For Turkey, the two-goal deficit is not insurmountable, but their remaining Group D fixtures now carry the weight of must-win encounters.

What It Means for the Standings

In Group D, Australia move to 3 points and put themselves in a strong position; Turkey sit on zero points and will need results in their remaining fixtures.

With 48 teams and a format that sends the top two from each group — plus the eight best third-placed sides — into the round of 32, the margins are tighter than they appear. Goal difference could prove decisive.

What's Next

Day 5 (Monday, June 15) brings 4 more group stage matches:

  • Spain vs Cape Verde — Group H at Mercedes-Benz Stadium, Atlanta
  • Belgium vs Egypt — Group G at Lumen Field, Seattle
  • Saudi Arabia vs Uruguay — Group H at Hard Rock Stadium, Miami
  • Iran vs New Zealand — Group G at SoFi Stadium, Los Angeles
